thessalonians1.2.p1.b1.text: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.

thessalonians1.2.p1.b2.text: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. …

thessalonians1.2.p1.b3.text: But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.

thessalonians1.2.p1.b4.text: … not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.

thessalonians1.2.p2.b1.text: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. …

thessalonians1.2.p2.b2.text: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.

thessalonians1.2.p2.b3.text: … we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.

thessalonians1.2.p3.b1.text: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day …

thessalonians1.2.p3.b2.text: … so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.

thessalonians1.2.p3.b3.text: … we treated each of you as a father treats his own children …

thessalonians1.2.p3.b4.text: … to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

thessalonians1.2.p4.b1.text: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God …

thessalonians1.2.p4.b2.text: … You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews, …

thessalonians1.2.p4.b3.text: … and drove us out as well. …

thessalonians1.2.p4.b4.text: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. …

thessalonians1.2.p5.b1.text: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), …

thessalonians1.2.p5.b2.text: … our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.

thessalonians1.2.p5.b3.text: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.

thessalonians1.2.p6.b1.text: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, …

thessalonians1.2.p6.b2.text: … if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?

thessalonians1.2.p6.b3.text: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
